component.name: WireGuard
component.summary: Cockpit extension for managing WireGuard VPN tunnels

description.p: A Cockpit extension for managing WireGuard VPN tunnels using the standard wg-quick configuration in /etc/wireguard. It reads and writes the same configuration files used by WireGuard directly, so existing tunnels are shown automatically and configuration persists even if the extension is removed. Includes guided wizards for creating tunnels and adding clients, live connection status, and per-client configuration with QR codes.
